parsed.internal_thinking: ג'ימי just stole a card from me and said 'מספיק עם החגיגה' (enough with the party). This is clearly retaliation for me placing the robber on hex 14 (Wh9) to block both him and Gemini. He's right to be annoyed - I blocked his wheat production at node 43. But this is the game. He moved the robber to hex 11 (O3), which blocks my ore from nodes 10 and 11. I still have 1 ore in hand, and my other ore source is node 25 (O3), which is still active. The card he stole is unknown - could be wheat, sheep, wood, or ore. My current hand: 2 wheat, 2 sheep, 1 ore, minus 1 stolen card = 4 cards left. My settlement at node 14 still needs 1 brick + 1 ore + 1 sheep + 1 wheat. I have the ore and sheep and wheat, but I'm still missing brick. ג'ימי's move is fair retaliation. I should not escalate further - that leads to a robber war nobody wins. Gemini is still the stronger long-term threat at 2 VP with strong resource engines. I need to focus on getting brick and building my third settlement before she does. Silence is the right move here - no need to complain or trash-talk back. Just accept the hit and move on.
